title: Divine revelation is general or special; its object and mode must be considered
pass_a_gloss: VI. Divine revelation is one general, which happens from nature, Romans 1:19; another special, which is granted above nature, John 17:6. VII. Of this, the object and the mode must be considered.
pass_b_english: VI. Divine revelation is of two kinds. One is general, coming from nature ([[Romans 1:19 >> Bible:Romans 1:19]]). The other is special, granted above nature ([[John 17:6 >> Bible:John 17:6]]).
VII. Of this revelation, both the object and the mode must be considered.
source_text:
VI. Revelatio divina alia est generalis, quae fit a natura, Rom. 1. 19. alia specialis, quae supra naturam conceditur, Joh. 17. 6.

VII. Hujus considerandum est objectum & modus.
